note: Granular task list. Mark done:true as each is completed, via /cerrar.

tasks.description: Scaffold repository: layout, continuity files, subagents, commands
ingest/dma.py: download Danish AIS for a date range, land as Parquet partitioned by date
Open the Parquet with DuckDB; confirm column schema, row count, distinct vessel count
Render one day of vessel positions on a static map. Goal: ships on screen on day one (code ready and tested against synthetic data; still needs pointing at the real downloaded day, see docs/STATE.md)
Dockerfile and reproducible environment
Clean AIS: drop invalid MMSI, impossible coordinates, duplicate messages
Identity resolution: link MMSI to IMO, detect reused and orphaned MMSI
Reconstruct tracks per vessel and segment into voyages
Unit tests with synthetic cases for each cleaning pathology
Empirical coverage map: receive probability per sea grid cell and vessel class. Core technical piece
Detector 1: deliberate AIS gaps. Output a probability, not a boolean
Detector 2: position spoofing (impossible speeds, positions on land, synthetic circles, simultaneous positions)
Detector 3: ship-to-ship transfers, using the GFW definition
Detector 4: identity anomalies (flag, name, MMSI changes)
Detector 5: declared-behaviour contradictions (draught vs port calls, destination vs heading)
Measure agreement of detector 3 against the GFW Events API
Ingest OFAC, EU and UK sanctions lists, capturing designation dates
Join sanctions to vessels by IMO and MMSI; quantify match rate and ambiguity
Build the labelled vessel-month panel
Naive baseline: tanker over 15 years old under a flag of convenience
Isolation Forest on the vessel-month features
LightGBM with rolling temporal cutoffs; report precision@20 and lift over baseline
Calibration: reliability curve and Brier score
SHAP attribution so every alert carries its reasons
Run analyst-review for temporal leakage and validation honesty
Write the label-bias section of the README
Export tracks, gaps and encounters as GeoJSON/Arrow for the map
deck.gl + MapLibre map: animated tracks, gaps in red, encounters marked
Publish to GitHub Pages; verify on mobile and desktop
Vessel dossier generator with explicit confidence levels
Live AISStream capture for Gibraltar/Ceuta, with compression enabled
Scheduled ingestion via GitHub Actions
Reproduce a known case: score a sanctioned vessel on its pre-designation history
Final README and second analyst-review pass
